description: Sun position, sunrise and sunset for a place and instant (NOAA equations) — Computes sun elevation, azimuth, declination, equation of time, sunrise, solar noon and sunset (UTC) for a latitude/longitude and up to 100 caller-supplied instants using the NOAA Global Monitoring Laboratory solar calculator equations (Meeus). Polar day and polar night return sunrise and sunset as null with a reason, not an error. Reads no clock: every instant comes from the caller. Does not mode

asOf.description: ISO 8601 instant with Z or numeric offset; the call never reads the clock.

claim.description: Optional claim about the asOf instant to check; tolerances default to 0.5 deg and 2 minutes.

azimuthDeg.description: Claimed azimuth, degrees clockwise from north.

sunrise.description: Claimed sunrise, ISO 8601 with Z or offset.

sunset.description: Claimed sunset, ISO 8601 with Z or offset.

items.description: ISO 8601 instant with Z or offset.

utcOffsetMinutes.description: Offset from UTC used to define the local calendar day for sunrise/sunset (default 0).

name: solar-position
